title: Vessel Identification
text: Every vessel must broadcast a unique MMSI number and call sign at all times when operating in monitored waters.

title: Position Reporting Interval
text: Class A transponders must report position at intervals no greater than 10 seconds when underway and 3 minutes when at anchor.

title: Static and Voyage Data
text: Vessels must transmit static and voyage-related data including ship name, destination, ETA, and maximum present static draught.

title: Transponder Equipment Standards
text: AIS transponders must comply with IEC 62287 (Class B) or IEC 61993-2 (Class A) equipment standards.

title: Safety-Related Messages
text: Safety-related messages may be broadcast on AIS to warn of hazards, distress, or urgent navigational information.

title: Speed Over Ground
text: Speed over ground (SOG) must be reported accurately to the nearest 0.1 knot.

title: Course Over Ground
text: Course over ground (COG) and true heading must be reported in degrees (0–359).

title: Navigation Status
text: The navigational status field must accurately reflect the vessel's current state (e.g., underway using engine, at anchor, moored).

title: Data Integrity
text: All transmitted AIS data must be verified for accuracy before transmission; erroneous data must be corrected immediately.

title: Record Keeping
text: AIS records must be retained for a minimum of 12 months and made available to competent authorities upon request.
